cp.description: Copy files and directories from a source to a destination.

fields.label: Source
fields.tooltip: The file or directory to copy.

fields.label: Destination
fields.tooltip: The location or new filename to copy to.

fields.label: Preserve attributes (-p)
fields.tooltip: Preserve mode, ownership, timestamps.

fields.label: Interactive (-i)
fields.tooltip: Prompt before overwrite.

ln.description: Create links between files (hard links or symbolic links).

fields.label: Target
fields.tooltip: The existing file or directory to link to.

fields.label: Link name
fields.tooltip: The name of the link to create.

fields.label: Symbolic link (-s)
fields.tooltip: Create a symbolic (soft) link instead of a hard link.

fields.label: Force (-f)
fields.tooltip: Remove existing destination files.

ls.description: List directory contents. Shows files and folders in the specified location.

fields.label: Path
fields.tooltip: Directory to list (e.g., /var/log). Leave blank for current directory.

fields.label: Long listing format (-l)
fields.tooltip: Show detailed information (permissions, owner, size).

fields.label: Include hidden files (-a)
fields.tooltip: Show all files, including those starting with .

fields.label: Human-readable sizes (-h)
fields.tooltip: Show sizes in KB, MB, GB (use with -l).

fields.label: Recursive list (-R)
fields.tooltip: List contents of subdirectories.

fields.label: Sort by time (-t)
fields.tooltip: Newest files first. Conflicts with Sort by size.

fields.label: Sort by size (-S)
fields.tooltip: Largest files first. Conflicts with Sort by time.

fields.label: Directory Name(s)
fields.tooltip:
Name of the directory to create, e.g., my_folder. 
Can be multiple names separated by spaces.

fields.label: Set permissions
fields.tooltip:
Set permissions in octal format.

Common values:
  755 (rwxr-xr-x): Owner all, others read/enter
  700 (rwx------): Owner all, others no access
  750 (rwxr-x---): Owner & Group can read/enter
  777 (rwxrwxrwx): Everyone all (use cautiously)

fields.label: Create parent directories (-p)
fields.tooltip:
Creates parent directories as needed. 
Use this to create a nested path like /home/user/chris all at once.

mv.description: Move or rename files and directories.

fields.label: Source
fields.tooltip: The file or directory to move/rename.

fields.label: Destination
fields.tooltip: The new location or new name.

fields.label: Interactive (-i)
fields.tooltip: Prompt before overwrite. Conflicts with No clobber.

fields.label: No clobber (-n)
fields.tooltip: Don't overwrite existing files. Conflicts with Interactive.

fields.label: Directory Path
fields.tooltip:
Enter path:
  /var/log (absolute)
  .. (up one dir)
  . (current dir)
  ~ (your home)
  ~user (another user's home)

Leave blank to go home.

fields.label: Go to previous directory (-)
fields.tooltip: Jump back to the last directory you were in.

pwd.description: Print the full path of the current working directory.

rm.description: Remove (delete) files or directories. Use with caution!

fields.label: File or Directory
fields.tooltip: The item to remove. Separate multiple files with spaces.

fields.label: Force (ignore warnings)
fields.tooltip: Ignore warnings. Conflicts with Interactive.

fields.label: Interactive (-i)
fields.tooltip: Prompt before every removal. Conflicts with Force.

touch.description: Create empty files or update timestamps of existing files.

fields.label: File(s)
fields.tooltip: File(s) to create or update. Space-separated.

tree.description: List directory contents in a tree-like format.

fields.label: Directory Path
fields.tooltip: Enter path to scan (e.g., /etc or ..). Leave blank to scan current directory.

fields.label: Max depth to show (-L)
fields.tooltip: e.g., 2. Limits how many levels deep the tree will go.

fields.label: Filter by pattern (-P)
fields.tooltip: Show only files matching this pattern, e.g., *.txt

fields.label: Ignore by pattern (-I)
fields.tooltip: Do not show files matching this pattern, e.g., *.log
